evals.prompt: Detect and map the ORM entities in this Spring Boot project that uses JPA with PostgreSQL
evals.expected_output: Produces database-mapping.md with entity-table mapping, Mermaid ER diagram, and unmapped tables list
expectations: Output includes a valid Mermaid erDiagram block
Generated markdown has proper frontmatter with type: entity

evals.prompt: I have a custom ORM that uses BaseModel classes with __table__ attributes. Help me create an ORM profile for it
evals.expected_output: Walks through Q&A and generates a custom YAML profile matching the ORM profile schema
expectations: Asks about detection markers and patterns
Generates a valid YAML profile with required fields (name, language, detection, entity_extraction)
Profile can be loaded by the profile loader without errors
